<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">

<meta property="og:title" content="Yak Doma — Ukrainian Shawarma &amp; Street Food in Dublin 1">
<meta property="og:description" content="Shawarma named after Ukrainian cities, borscht, dumplings, loaded hot dogs and desserts in Dublin 1. Dine-in, takeaway or Deliveroo.">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://example.com/">

<meta name="twitter:title" content="Yak Doma — Ukrainian Shawarma &amp; Street Food in Dublin 1">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Shawarma named after Ukrainian cities, borscht, dumplings, loaded hot dogs and desserts in Dublin 1.">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://example.com/assets/og-image.jpg">
<!-- Icons (generated from the Yak Doma emblem) -->
<link rel="icon" href="favicon.ico" sizes="any">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="assets/favicon-32.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="assets/apple-touch-icon.png">
<!-- GA4: вставити тег тут -->
<!-- Meta Pixel: вставити тут -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,400..900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ==========================================================
   DESIGN TOKENS
   Direction from references: cream + deep green + checkerboard
   (smash'd), signal red + chunky rounded wordmark (MA Studio),
   giant condensed type over food (Food Frenzy), bold labels on
   full-bleed food tiles (ingredient grid), flash-photo energy
   for reactions (cap photo).
   ========================================================== */
:root{
  --cream:#F6ECD9;
  --cream-2:#EFE0C3;
  --paper:#FBF6EC;
  --green:#0E4B2F;
  --green-2:#093621;
  --red:#C8161D;
  --red-dark:#9C0F14;
  --pink:#F3A9C6;
  --corn:#F2B63D;
  --beet:#7A1530;
  --ink:#1A1714;
  --night:#141210;
  --sign:#111111;
  --ua-blue:#0057B7;
  --ua-yellow:#FFD700;

  --f-display:"Anton", Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif;

  --wrap:1240px;
  --gutter:clamp(16px, 4vw, 40px);
  --radius:22px;
  --check:44px;
  --shadow-hard:4px 4px 0 var(--ink);
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.55;overflow-x:hidden}
img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;font-weight:400;line-height:.92}
p{margin:0}
ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
section[id]{scroll-margin-top:84px}

.wrap{width:100%;max-width:var(--wrap);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
.sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.skip{position:absolute;left:12px;top:-60px;z-index:100;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;text-decoration:none}
.skip:focus{top:12px}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--corn);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}

/* ---------- Shared bits ---------- */
.checker{height:var(--check);background:repeating-conic-gradient(var(--green) 0 25%, var(--cream) 0 50%) 0 0/calc(var(--check)*2) calc(var(--check)*2)}
.checker--red{background:repeating-conic-gradient(var(--red) 0 25%, var(--cream) 0 50%) 0 0/calc(var(--check)*2) calc(var(--check)*2)}

.eyebrow{font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:800;font-stretch:125%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:.8rem}
.h2{font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6.5rem);letter-spacing:.005em}
.lead{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.4vw,1.2rem);max-width:46ch}

.btn{--bg:var(--red);--fg:var(--cream);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5em;min-height:48px;padding:.8em 1.5em;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:800;font-stretch:112%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:.95rem;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:var(--shadow-hard);transition:transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover{transform:translate(-2px,-2px);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn:active{transform:translate(2px,2px);box-shadow:1px 1px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn--cream{--bg:var(--cream);--fg:var(--ink)}
.btn--green{--bg:var(--green);--fg:var(--cream)}
.btn--pink{--bg:var(--pink);--fg:var(--ink)}
.btn--ghost{--bg:transparent;--fg:currentColor;box-shadow:none;border-color:currentColor}
.btn--ghost:hover{box-shadow:none;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn--sm{min-height:44px;padding:.6em 1.15em;font-size:.82rem}
.btn svg{width:1.1em;height:1.1em}

/* placeholder label — makes unverified content obvious */
.tbc{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;padding:.2em .6em;border:1.5px dashed currentColor;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;font-stretch:110%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;opacity:.85;white-space:nowrap}

/* ---------- Concept bar ---------- */
.concept-bar{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);text-align:center;font-size:.78rem;padding:.5em var(--gutter);letter-spacing:.02em}
.concept-bar strong{color:var(--pink);font-weight:700}

/* ---------- 01 Header ---------- */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:var(--sign);color:#fff;border-top:8px solid var(--ua-blue);border-bottom:8px solid var(--ua-yellow)}
.header__inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;min-height:72px}
.logo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--green);margin-right:auto}
.logo img{height:44px;width:auto}
.nav ul{display:flex;gap:.25rem}
.nav a{display:inline-block;padding:.6em .9em;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-stretch:112%;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.nav a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.header__cta{box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #fff}
.header__cta:hover{box-shadow:6px 6px 0 #fff}
.nav-toggle{display:none;width:48px;height:48px;border:2.5px solid #fff;border-radius:14px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;place-items:center}
.burger,.burger::before,.burger::after{display:block;width:20px;height:2.5px;background:#fff;border-radius:2px;transition:transform .2s ease, opacity .2s ease;content:""}
.burger{position:relative}
.burger::before{position:absolute;top:-6px}
.burger::after{position:absolute;top:6px}
.nav-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .burger{background:transparent}
.nav-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .burger::before{transform:translateY(6px) rotate(45deg)}
.nav-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .burger::after{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg)}

@media (max-width:760px){
  .nav-toggle{display:grid}
  .nav{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);background:var(--sign);border-bottom:8px solid var(--ua-yellow);padding:.5rem var(--gutter) 1.25rem;display:none}
  .nav.is-open{display:block}
  .nav ul{flex-direction:column}
  .nav a{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:400;padding:.25em 0;border-radius:0;border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
  .header__cta{display:none}
  .logo img{height:36px}
}

/* ---------- 02 Hero ---------- */
.hero{--fs:clamp(4.6rem,21vw,17.5rem);position:relative;isolation:isolate;background:var(--night);color:var(--cream);overflow:hidden;min-height:min(calc(100svh - 110px),960px);display:flex;align-items:center;padding-block:clamp(40px,6vw,80px)}
.hero{flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:clamp(20px,3vw,44px)!important;padding-bottom:clamp(28px,4vw,56px)!important;min-height:calc(100svh - 104px)!important}
.hero > .wrap,.hero__inner{width:100%}
.hero__bg,.hero__cut{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 35%;filter:brightness(.72)}
.hero__bg{z-index:1}
.hero__cut{z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
/* darkening only towards the bottom, for the copy & buttons; transparent where the headline sits */
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,8,6,0) 0%,rgba(10,8,6,0) 40%,rgba(10,8,6,.65) 100%)}
.hero.no-photo{background:var(--red)}
.hero.no-photo::before{display:none}
.hero__kicker{position:relative;z-index:6;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;text-align:center}
.hero__kicker .dot{opacity:.6}
.hero__inner{padding-inline:clamp(10px,1.6vw,24px)}
.hero__titlewrap{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(12px,1.6vw,22px)}
.hero__title{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:900;font-stretch:100%;line-height:.9}
/* outline copy painted above the cut-out — text looks transparent where it crosses the photo subject */
.hero__title--outline{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px var(--cream);pointer-events:none}
.hero__line{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.hero__line > span{display:inline-block}
.hero > .wrap{margin-top:auto;padding-top:clamp(24px,4vw,48px)}
.hero__copy{position:relative;z-index:6;display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:1.25rem;text-align:center}
.hero__copy p{max-width:62ch;font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.4vw,1.25rem);text-wrap:balance}
.hero__ctas{display:flex;gap:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.hero .btn--ghost{color:var(--cream)}

/* ---------- 03 Signature Shawarma ---------- */
.section{padding-block:clamp(64px,9vw,120px)}
.section__head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:1.5rem 3rem;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(32px,5vw,56px)}
.section__head .eyebrow{grid-column:1/-1;color:var(--red)}
.section__head .side{display:grid;gap:1.2rem;justify-items:start}
@media (max-width:860px){.section__head{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* section intro: compact 3-line block */
.section__head .side{justify-self:end}
.section__head .lead{max-width:var(--lead-w,24ch);text-wrap:balance;line-height:1.4}
@media (max-width:860px){.section__head .side{justify-self:start}}

.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,260px),1fr));gap:clamp(16px,2vw,24px)}
/* card width is capped so a whole card (4:5 photo + text) fits the screen height under the sticky header */
.cards--two{--gap:clamp(16px,1.8vw,24px);--hcap:max(240px, calc((100svh - 380px) / 1.25));grid-template-columns:min(100%,var(--hcap));justify-content:center;gap:var(--gap)}
@media (min-width:640px){.cards--two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,min(calc((100% - var(--gap)) / 2),var(--hcap)))}}
@media (min-width:1000px){.cards--two{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,min(calc((100% - 2 * var(--gap)) / 3),var(--hcap)))}}
.card--extras .card__media{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;text-align:center;padding:20px}
.card--extras .extras__big{font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:900;font-stretch:125%;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4.4vw,4rem);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--cream)}
.card--extras .extras__plus{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:clamp(4rem,8vw,7rem);line-height:.8;color:var(--pink)}
.card--extras .rows{margin-top:.2rem}
.card--extras .row{padding:.45rem 0}
.card--extras .row__name{font-size:.88rem}
.card--extras .row__price{font-size:1.3rem}
.cards--two .card__media{aspect-ratio:4/5}
.cards--two .card__media img{object-position:center top}
.cards--two .card__body{padding:18px 22px 20px;gap:.5rem}
.cards--two .card__title{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,2.8vw,2.8rem)}
.cards--two .card__desc{font-size:.98rem}
.cards--two .price{font-size:2.1rem}
.card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--paper);border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;transition:transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink)}
.card__media{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;display:grid;place-items:center;border-bottom:2.5px solid var(--ink);overflow:hidden}
.card__media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.card__media .art{width:52%;height:auto}
.card__media .tbc{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;background:inherit}
.card__body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;padding:18px 18px 20px;flex:1}
.card__kicker{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;font-stretch:120%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--red)}
.card__title{font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-size:2.6rem;line-height:.95}
.card__desc{font-size:.95rem;color:#4a423a}
.card__note{align-self:flex-start;color:#6b5f52}
.card__foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;margin-top:auto;padding-top:.75rem}
.price{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:1.9rem;line-height:1;color:var(--green)}

.tone-green{background:var(--green);color:var(--pink)}
.tone-red{background:var(--red);color:var(--cream)}
.tone-cream{background:var(--cream-2);color:var(--green)}
.tone-pink{background:var(--pink);color:var(--green)}
.tone-corn{background:var(--corn);color:var(--ink)}
.tone-beet{background:var(--beet);color:var(--pink)}

.inline-link{font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.badge{display:inline-block;margin-left:.4em;padding:.15em .55em;border-radius:999px;background:var(--corn);color:var(--ink);font-size:.95em;letter-spacing:.06em;vertical-align:1px}
.card__tagline{font-weight:700;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.35}
.row__sub{display:block;margin-top:.15rem;font-weight:500;font-stretch:100%;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:.82rem;color:#6b5f52}
.ticket__group{margin:1.3rem 0 0;font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:800;font-stretch:120%;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--red)}
.addons{margin-top:2rem;font-size:.95rem;max-width:80ch}
.addons strong{font-weight:800;font-stretch:115%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--red);margin-right:.35em}
.source-note{margin-top:1.75rem;font-size:.82rem;color:#6b5f52}

/* ---------- 04 Taste of Ukraine (ingredient-grid reference) ---------- */
.ukraine{background:var(--paper)}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden}
.tile{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;}
@media (min-width:761px){.tile{aspect-ratio:16/10}}
.tile{display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.tile:nth-child(odd){border-right:2.5px solid var(--ink)}
.tile:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:2.5px solid var(--ink)}
.tile .art{position:absolute;width:78%;opacity:.35;z-index:-1}
.tile img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-1}
.tile__label{font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:900;font-stretch:125%;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(1.3rem,4vw,3.4rem);letter-spacing:.01em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.25);text-align:center;padding-inline:8px}
.tile__cap{position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:14px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.tile__cap .tbc{color:#fff}
.tile.tone-cream .tile__label,.tile.tone-cream .tile__cap,.tile.tone-cream .tile__cap .tbc{color:var(--green);text-shadow:none}
.tile.tone-corn .tile__label,.tile.tone-corn .tile__cap,.tile.tone-corn .tile__cap .tbc{color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none}
.tile.has-img .art{display:none}
.tile.has-img::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,10,6,.18) 0%,rgba(15,10,6,.38) 100%)}
.tile.has-img .tile__label,.tile.has-img .tile__cap,.tile.has-img .tile__cap .tbc{color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.also{margin-top:1.5rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center}
.also span.pill{padding:.45em .9em;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;background:var(--cream)}
@media (max-width:520px){.tile__cap{font-size:.72rem;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:10px}.tile__cap .tbc{display:none}}

/* ---------- 05 Something Sweet ---------- */
.sweet{background:var(--pink);color:var(--green)}
.sweet .section__head .eyebrow{color:var(--red-dark)}
.sweet .card{background:var(--cream)}
@media (min-width:561px){.cards--three{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (min-width:1000px){.cards--three{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.cards--three .card__media{aspect-ratio:1/1}
.sweet .card__title{font-size:2rem;color:var(--ink)}

/* ---------- 06 Combos & Extras ---------- */
.combos{background:var(--green);color:var(--cream)}
.combos .section__head .eyebrow{color:var(--pink)}
.combo-grid{display:grid;align-items:stretch;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(16px,2vw,24px)}
@media (max-width:980px){.combo-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ticket{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:clamp(20px,3vw,32px)}
.ticket__title{font-family:var(--f-display);text-transform:uppercase;font-size:2.2rem;line-height:1}
.ticket__sub{margin-top:.35rem;font-size:.92rem;color:#5a5047}
.rows{margin-top:1.1rem}
.row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.6rem;padding:.75rem 0;border-top:2px dashed #cdbd9f}
.row__name{font-weight:800;font-stretch:112%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em}
.row__fill{flex:1;border-bottom:2px dotted #b9a888;transform:translateY(-4px);min-width:16px}
.row__price{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:1.55rem;line-height:1;color:var(--red)}
.row .tbc{font-size:.66rem}
.extras{display:contents}
.combos__cta{margin-top:clamp(28px,4vw,44px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:center}
.combos .source-note{color:#bcd2c4}

/* ---------- 07 Customer Reactions ---------- */
.reactions{background:var(--night);color:var(--cream)}
.reactions .section__head .eyebrow{color:var(--pink)}
.reels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(12px,1.6vw,20px)}
@media (max-width:760px){.reels{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,72%);overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding-bottom:12px;margin-inline:calc(var(--gutter)*-1);padding-inline:var(--gutter)}.reel{scroll-snap-align:start}}
.reel{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/2.167;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;border:2px solid #3a332c;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 38%, #4a3f35 0%, #241e19 45%, #0d0b09 100%);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:24px}
.reel::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(60% 40% at 50% 40%, rgba(255,240,220,.18), transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.reel__icon{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid var(--cream);display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 14px}
.reel__icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;transform:translateX(2px)}
.reel p{font-size:.92rem;max-width:22ch;margin-inline:auto;color:#e8dcc6}
.reel--photo{padding:0;background:#0d0b09}
.reel--photo::before{display:none}
.reel__bg,.reel__fg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:var(--img);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center}
.reel__bg{background-size:cover;filter:blur(22px) brightness(.55);transform:scale(1.15)}
.reel__fg{background-size:contain}
.reel--video{padding:0;background:#000}
.reel--video::before{display:none}
.reel--video iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
.reel__mask{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d0b09 0%,#0d0b09 86%,rgba(13,11,9,0) 100%)}
.reel .tbc{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;color:var(--pink)}
.reactions__foot{margin-top:clamp(24px,3vw,36px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem 1.5rem;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.reactions__foot p{max-width:58ch;color:#cfc3ad;font-size:.95rem}

/* ---------- 08 Visit ---------- */
.visit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,40px);align-items:stretch}
@media (max-width:860px){.visit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.info{display:grid;gap:0;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--paper);overflow:hidden}
.info__row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:1rem;padding:18px 22px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--cream-2);align-items:start}
.info__row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.info dt{font-weight:800;font-stretch:120%;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--red);padding-top:.25em}
.info dd{margin:0;display:grid;gap:.35rem;justify-items:start}
.info dd strong{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:400;font-size:1.6rem;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1}
@media (max-width:480px){.info__row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.35rem}}
.visit__ctas{display:flex;gap:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.5rem}
.map{position:relative;min-height:340px;border:2.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;background:var(--green);color:var(--cream);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:28px}
.map::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-conic-gradient(rgba(246,236,217,.07) 0 25%, transparent 0 50%) 0 0/64px 64px}
.map__pin{width:72px;margin:0 auto 12px;color:var(--pink)}
.map p{position:relative;max-width:30ch}
.map iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;z-index:1}
.map__fallback{position:relative;z-index:0}
/* brand badge pinned next to the Google marker (marker sits at the map centre on load) */
.map__badge{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:calc(50% - 78px);top:calc(50% - 74px);width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:#111;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none}
.map__badge img{width:62%;height:auto}

/* ---------- 09 Footer ---------- */
.site-footer{background:var(--sign);color:var(--cream);padding-block:clamp(48px,7vw,80px) 28px}
.footer__logo{width:clamp(240px,34vw,440px);height:auto}
.footer__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2rem;margin-top:clamp(28px,4vw,48px);padding-top:28px;border-top:2px solid rgba(246,236,217,.18)}
@media (max-width:760px){.footer__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.footer__grid h2{font-family:var(--f-body);font-weight:800;font-stretch:120%;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pink);margin-bottom:.8rem;line-height:1.2}
.footer__grid li{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.footer__grid .tbc{white-space:normal}
.footer__grid > div{min-width:0}
.footer__grid a{text-decoration:none}
.footer__grid a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.footer__legal{margin-top:36px;font-size:.8rem;color:#a8a29a;display:grid;gap:.4rem}

/* ---------- Mobile sticky order bar ---------- */
.order-bar{display:none}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .order-bar{display:flex;position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:60;transition:transform .25s ease}
  .order-bar .btn{flex:1;min-height:54px;font-size:1rem}
  .order-bar.is-hidden{transform:translateY(140%)}
  body{padding-bottom:84px}
}
</style>
<script>
/* ---------- Hero photo ---------- */
function heroPhotoError(img){
  const orig = img.src.replace(/\/upload\/[^/]*,[^/]*\//, "/upload/");
  if (orig !== img.src && !img.dataset.retried){ img.dataset.retried = "1"; img.src = orig; return; }
  img.remove(); document.querySelector(".hero").classList.add("no-photo");
}
</script>

/* ---------- Components ---------- */
// If a resized Cloudinary URL fails, try the original; if that fails too, show a labelled placeholder
function imgFallback(img){
  const orig = img.src.replace(/\/upload\/[^/]*,[^/]*\//, "/upload/");
  if (orig !== img.src && !img.dataset.retried){ img.dataset.retried = "1"; img.src = orig; return; }
  const box = img.parentElement; img.remove();
  box.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", '<svg class="art" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-cake"/></svg><span class="tbc">Photo unavailable</span>');
}
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
const tbc = t => `<span class="tbc">${esc(t)}</span>`;
const media = (item, art, alt) => item.img
  ? `<img src="${esc(item.img)}" alt="${esc(alt)}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="${item.w || 900}" height="${item.h || 900}" onerror="imgFallback(this)">`
  : `<svg class="art" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-${art}"/></svg>${tbc("Photo to come")}`;
const orderBtn = (label, sr, cls="btn btn--sm") =>
  `<a class="${cls}" href="${ORDER_URL}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${label}<span class="sr-only"> ${esc(sr)} on Deliveroo (opens in a new tab)</span></a>`;

const ProductCard = (p, kicker, art) => `
  <article class="card">
    <div class="card__media tone-${p.tone}">${media(p, art, p.name + " shawarma")}</div>
    <div class="card__body">
      <p class="card__kicker">${esc(kicker)}${p.badge ? ` <span class="badge">${esc(p.badge)}</span>` : ""}</p>
      <h3 class="card__title">${esc(p.name)}</h3>
      ${p.tagline ? `<p class="card__tagline">${esc(p.tagline)}</p>` : ""}
      ${p.desc ? `<p class="card__desc">${esc(p.desc)}</p>` : ""}
      ${p.note ? `<span class="tbc card__note">${esc(p.note)}</span>` : ""}
      <div class="card__foot">
        ${p.price ? `<span class="price">${esc(p.price)}</span>` : tbc("Price TBC")}
        ${orderBtn("Order", p.name)}
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>`;

const SweetCard = p => `
  <article class="card">
    <div class="card__media tone-${p.tone}">${media(p, p.art, p.alt || p.name)}</div>
    <div class="card__body">
      <p class="card__kicker">Desserts</p>
      <h3 class="card__title">${esc(p.name)}</h3>
      <span class="tbc card__note">Official name &amp; price TBC</span>
    </div>
  </article>`;

const Tile = d => `
  <figure class="tile tone-${d.tone}${d.img ? " has-img" : ""}" style="margin:0">
    ${d.img ? `<img src="${esc(d.img)}" alt="${esc(d.name)}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="${d.w || 800}" height="${d.h || 600}">` : `<svg class="art" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-${d.art}"/></svg>`}
    <span class="tile__label" aria-hidden="true">${esc(d.label)}</span>
    <figcaption class="tile__cap"><span>${esc(d.name)}</span>${d.price ? `<span>${esc(d.price)}</span>` : tbc(d.img ? "Price TBC" : "Photo & price TBC")}</figcaption>
  </figure>`;

const Row = r => `
  <li class="row"><span class="row__name">${esc(r.name)}${r.sub ? `<small class="row__sub">${esc(r.sub)}</small>` : ""}</span><span class="row__fill" aria-hidden="true"></span>${r.price ? `<span class="row__price">${esc(r.price)}</span>` : tbc("Price TBC")}</li>`;

const Reel = r => r.photo ? `
  <div class="reel reel--photo" role="img" aria-label="${esc(r.alt || "Customer photo")}" style="--img:url('${r.photo}')">
    <span class="reel__bg" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="reel__fg" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  </div>` : r.vimeo ? `
  <div class="reel reel--video">
    <iframe src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/${esc(r.vimeo)}?badge=0&autopause=0&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0&loop=1&dnt=1" title="${esc(r.title || "Customer video")}" loading="lazy" frameborder="0" allow="autoplay; fullscreen; picture-in-picture; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>${r.maskTop ? `<span class="reel__mask" style="height:${+r.maskTop}%" aria-hidden="true"></span>` : ""}
  </div>` : `
  <div class="reel">${tbc("Placeholder")}
    <div><span class="reel__icon"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-play"/></svg></span><p>${esc(r.text)}</p></div>
  </div>`;

const render = (key, fn) => { const el = document.querySelector(`[data-render="${key}"]`); if (el) el.innerHTML = CONTENT[key].map(fn).join(""); };
render("shawarma", p => ProductCard(p, "Regional shawarma", "shawarma"));
{ const el = document.querySelector('[data-render="shawarma"]');
  if (el) el.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `
  <article class="card card--extras">
    <div class="card__media tone-green"><span class="extras__plus" aria-hidden="true">+</span><span class="extras__big">Add<br>extra</span></div>
    <div class="card__body">
      <p class="card__kicker">Make it yours</p>
      <ul class="rows">${CONTENT.extras.map(Row).join("")}</ul>
    </div>
  </article>`); }
render("ukraine", Tile);
render("sweets", SweetCard);
render("combos", Row);
render("hotdogs", Row);
render("sides", Row);
render("coffee", Row);
render("drinks", Row);
render("reels", Reel);

/* Vimeo reels: never reach Vimeo's end screen (which shows the uploader's name).
   The embed loops (fallback if the API script can't load); with the API we pause on the first frame when it wraps around. */
(function(){
  const frames = document.querySelectorAll(".reel--video iframe");
  if (!frames.length) return;
  const s = document.createElement("script");
  s.src = "https://player.vimeo.com/api/player.js";
  s.onload = () => frames.forEach(f => {
    const p = new Vimeo.Player(f); let last = 0, dur = 0;
    p.getDuration().then(d => dur = d).catch(() => {});
    p.on("timeupdate", e => {
      if (dur && last > dur - 1.5 && e.seconds < 1) { p.pause(); p.setCurrentTime(0); }
      last = e.seconds;
    });
  });
  document.head.appendChild(s);
})();

/* every [data-order] link → Deliveroo */
document.querySelectorAll("[data-order]").forEach(a => {
  a.href = ORDER_URL; a.target = "_blank"; a.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
  if (!a.querySelector(".sr-only")) a.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", '<span class="sr-only"> on Deliveroo (opens in a new tab)</span>');
});

/* fit hero headline lines to the full width */
function fitHero(){
  // One calm line on desktop, three equal lines on phones; uniform size, ~90% of the width
  const wrap = document.querySelector(".hero__titlewrap");
  const solid = document.querySelector("h1.hero__title .hero__lines"), outline = document.querySelector(".hero__title--outline .hero__lines");
  if (!wrap || !solid) return;
  const W = wrap.clientWidth, narrow = W < 700, FILL = narrow ? 0.86 : 0.9;
  const lines = narrow ? ["Bold", "Ukrainian", "Flavour"] : ["Bold Ukrainian Flavour"];
  solid.innerHTML = lines.map(t => `<span class="hero__line" style="font-size:100px;letter-spacing:-0.03em"><span>${t}</span></span>`).join("");
  const widest = Math.max(...[...solid.querySelectorAll(".hero__line > span")].map(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().width));
  const fs = 100 * W * FILL / widest;
  solid.querySelectorAll(".hero__line").forEach(l => l.style.fontSize = fs + "px");
  if (outline) outline.innerHTML = solid.innerHTML;
}
fitHero();
window.addEventListener("resize", fitHero);
if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(fitHero);

/* mobile nav */
const toggle = document.querySelector(".nav-toggle"), nav = document.getElementById("site-nav");
const setNav = open => { toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open); nav.classList.toggle("is-open", open); };
toggle.addEventListener("click", () => setNav(toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true"));
nav.addEventListener("click", e => { if (e.target.closest("a")) setNav(false); });
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape" && nav.classList.contains("is-open")) { setNav(false); toggle.focus(); } });

/* hide sticky mobile order bar while hero or footer CTA is on screen */
const bar = document.getElementById("order-bar");
if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
  const watched = [document.querySelector(".hero__ctas"), document.querySelector(".site-footer")];
  const visible = new Set();
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(en => en.isIntersecting ? visible.add(en.target) : visible.delete(en.target));
    bar.classList.toggle("is-hidden", visible.size > 0);
  });
  watched.forEach(el => el && io.observe(el));
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
